title: AMD Shares Slide After AI Growth Outlook Underwhelms Investors
description: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. tumbled in late trading after giving an underwhelming sales outlook, a sign shareholders expected more of a return from the global expansion of AI data centers.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic AI Models Involved in More Security Incidents
description: Artificial intelligence models from OpenAI and Anthropic took unauthorized actions on the public Internet and, in some cases, attempted to add harmful code to online software, marking the latest in a string of breaches that have heightened concerns that AI providers can’t fully control their creations.

title: Fmr. Harvard Researcher on the Economics of SpaceX
description: Sinead O'Sullivan, Economist and Former Senior Researcher at Harvard Business School's Institute for Strategy and Competitiveness, discussed the current state and future prospects of SpaceX's Starship program. She emphasized that while investors remain optimistic, the technology is not yet fully developed due to the immense complexity of Starship compared to the Falcon rocket. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
